item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 02/Sep/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an anticyclone aloft, the weather will be mainly fine and persistently very hot over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days, but showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. An area of low pressure may develop within the broad trough of low pressure over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea to the vicinity of Luzon in the latter part of this week. However, its development and movement remain uncertain, with a higher chance of moving towards the coast of southern China early next week. There will be more showers with squally thunderstorms over the region. Besides, the area of low pressure now over the seas east of Taiwan will develop slightly and move in the general direction of the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
